newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Katonah-Lewisboro UFSD, N.Y.

text.p: SUMMARYNOTICEOFSALE
Katonah-Lewisboro Union Free School District
(Westchester County)
New York
School District Serial Bonds-1997A
(NOTbank qualified) (book-entry only)
SALE: 11:00 o'clock AM Wednesday, February 26, 1997
at Hawkins, Delafield & Wood, 67 Wall Street, New York, New
York
Bonds dated February 15, 1997, interest April 15 and October 15 each year commencing October 15, 1997. Bonds mature in principal installments on April 15 as follows:
$320,000 in the year 1998 $685,000 in the year
$460,000 in the year 1999 $730,000 in the year
$485,000 in the year 2000 $775,000 in the year
$500,000 in the year 2001 $810,000 in the year
$525,000 in the year 2002 $850,000 in the year
$555,000 in the year 2003 $905,000 in the year
$595,000 in the year 2004 $955,000 in the year
$625,000 in the year 2005 $1,010,000 in the year 2014*
$650,000 in the year 2006 $1,065,000 in the year 2015*
(*CALLABLEMATURITIES)

The District reserves the right to change the time and/or date of the bid opening, and notice thereof shall be provided at least 24 hours prior to the time set forth above and transmitted over the Munifacts wire.
Bids, accompanied by $250,000 good faith deposit check, must be for all $12,500,000 bonds. Award shall be based on true interest cost.

Bidders must refer to the full Notice of Sale for the complete terms and conditions of the sale. Copies of said Notice and the Official Statement may be promptly obtained from Public Finance Associates, Inc., 775 Route 82, Hopewell Junction, New York 12533: phone: (914) 227-8678; fax: (914) 227-6154.
Dated: February 18, 1997
LISBETH L. FUMAGALLI
President of the Board of Education
(From The Bond Buyer)
